note: PROPOSAL for Will to edit: the eval's topic set. Unlike the front page on purpose (nothing from FRONT or EARLIER in lib/front.js), two topics for each of the twelve kinds, then questions, a connecting pair and an ambiguous name. `numbers: true` marks topics whose numbers are easy to get wrong. `source` is the Wikipedia article a fact check reads against. `input` is exactly what the page writer receives (pageInput in lib/prompts.js).

topics.why: a law that is all numbers
an idea with a famous, often embellished story (Wald's bombers)
rare, filmed once or twice, easy to over-claim
temperatures quoted across orders of magnitude
a mechanism that needs steps, not adjectives
a mechanical thing whose history is full of names and dates
a technique with deep, disputed origins
a technique that invites umbrella links (navigation, the sea)
exact frequency, duration and date
an undeciphered script: a stock curiosity is one step away
a strange object with a long history of claims
legend, modern myth and real metallurgy tangled together
its origin story and dates are commonly misstated
endemism percentages that drift from source to source
a death toll, a date and a tonnage
a small event whose numbers are often inflated
dates in millions of years and an oxygen figure
an era with disputed boundaries and causes
a person whose story is often simplified
1729, dates and counts of results
a creature with famous, half-true regeneration claims
a lifespan estimate with a wide interval
a length, a count of figures and a date
exact contents (tracks, greetings, images)
a question with a partly unsettled answer
